Fig. 5.1 shows a water vole, *Arvicola amphibius*. This species is native to Great Britain.

{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}

Fig. 5.1

The numbers of water voles are estimated to have fallen by $94\%$ in the last century.

This is thought to be due to habitat fragmentation and also to extensive predation by mink, *Neovison vison*, shown in Fig. 5.2. Mink originated in North America but were brought to Great Britain for fur farming. Some escaped or were released into the wild, where their numbers rapidly increased.

{{figure:figure_5_2.png}}

Fig. 5.2
